$Comment: The binding row for the Gobliterator's hard mode (Goblin_Gobliterator_Encounter_Hard), the fight
the arena's difficulty lever switches on. It keeps its records under the bucket
goblin_gobliterator_hard, a boss of its own on Records' Bosses tab in the Deepworks group (Leaderboard
Group), named by the game's own hard-mode name (the one its boss bar shows), beside the standard
hard, which every credited player's ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED carries as its Qualifier, so a step,
contract or achievement can ask for a hard win alone.
Like the standard row it names the script's own slot for the machine (Gobliterator) and writes
nothing else, so the fight runs as the game authored it. Switch it off with Enabled false, or
from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounters.json under the key goblin_gobliterator_encounter_hard.
